findingDetails.title: Upcoming release entry v4.0.0.2 does not mention the validation off switches
findingDetails.evidence: The README calls v4.0.0.2 the untagged upcoming entry; the switch commits (2026-09-28 10:02 +0200) predate the entry's last update (47432cf846, 14:19 +0200); no release entry mentions the switches.
